P.recommendation:
**P — customer request population.** Joint distribution of customer seal-sizing requests: gland envelopes, pressure/temperature histories, approved material/lot variation, and mating tolerances. Conditional joint behaviour matters; independent uniform squeeze and pressure boxes are not a customer law.

**Q — diagnostic/acquisition proposal.** Enrich near contact-loss, overstrain and support/extrusion boundaries while retaining the same material and pressure-service domain. Oversample disagreement with the supplier-handbook/contact-surface baseline. Tag every diagnostic design; do not interpret its density as P.

**w — evidence/score use.** Sampling/evidence weighting and any correction from Q to P are **HUMAN_INPUT — scientific owner**. Prospective per-stratum admissibility and reporting precede any ranking. Equal diagnostic counts are a collection convenience, not deployment weights. No soft objective can compensate for a mandatory failure.

Freeze a versioned population contract with joint variables, support, dependencies, strata/mixture probabilities, rights, exclusions, time validity and applicability. Keep request-job law distinct from the finite design menu conditional on that job. Request population and design-generation process are not interchangeable. action_set.recommendation:
An explicitly bounded gland/seal geometry, nonlinear elastomer and rigid or deformable support, with assembly then service loading. An axisymmetric ring/gland is the cheapest proposed starting scope; permitting non-axisymmetric cuts or complex damage models changes the reference and price. Contact-pressure/extrusion proxies screen mechanics only; leakage, permeation, chemical compatibility and lifetime require separately applicable evidence if the buyer needs them.

Mandatory-stratum hypothesis (count [3,3,3]):

- approved low-temperature/assembly condition: numerical endpoints, joint conditions and source HUMAN_INPUT.
- approved nominal service condition: numerical endpoints, joint conditions and source HUMAN_INPUT.
- approved hot/high-pressure service condition: numerical endpoints, joint conditions and source HUMAN_INPUT.

Scientific owner must confirm that these strata cover the unchanged customer job. Initial/boundary conditions, histories, idealisations, material applicability, neglected physics and manufacture/assembly tolerances are HUMAN_INPUT. A missing safety/material requirement stops the affected job; it is never relaxed to save compute. No physical population claim follows from deterministic execution.
